topSpeed.label: Top speed (m/s)
topSpeed.help: Flat-out speed in metres per second. x 3.6 = km/h (42 = about 150 km/h). The camera, sound and speed lines all scale with it.

accel.label: Acceleration
accel.help: Push from the engine at a standstill; it fades as you near top speed. Higher = quicker off the line and out of corners.

brake.label: Brakes
brake.help: How hard the brake slows the car, in m/s lost per second. Strong brakes are forgiving: you can brake late.

coast.label: Coasting drag
coast.help: How quickly the car slows with no pedals pressed. Low = it rolls on, high = it feels like engine braking.

reverseSpeed.label: Reverse speed
reverseSpeed.help: Top speed backwards (hold brake when stopped).

turnLow.label: Turning at low speed
turnLow.help: How fast the nose swings round when slow (radians per second at full lock). High = nimble in hairpins.

turnHigh.label: Turning at top speed
turnHigh.help: The same at top speed. LOWER than the slow value on purpose: less lock at speed keeps the car steady on straights. Raise it if fast corners feel like a bus.

turnFullAt.label: Full steering from (m/s)
turnFullAt.help: Below this speed the steering fades out, so the car can't spin on the spot.

grip.label: Grip
grip.help: How fast sideways sliding dies away when NOT drifting. High = on rails. Low = loose, like ice.

tapSteer.label: Keyboard: tap bite
tapSteer.help: A key tap gives this share of full steering at once (then it ramps up). It is what makes small corrections possible on a keyboard.

steerTime.label: Keyboard: time to full lock (s)
steerTime.help: How long a held key takes to reach full steering. Short = twitchy, long = lazy.

centreTime.label: Keyboard: self-centre time (s)
centreTime.help: How fast the wheel straightens when you let go.

stickCurve.label: Gamepad stick curve
stickCurve.help: 1 = straight line. Higher = small stick movements steer less, for precision near the centre.

hillPull.label: Hills slow you
hillPull.help: How much gravity slows the car uphill and speeds it downhill. 0 = hills are only scenery.

minSpeed.label: Slowest drift (m/s)
minSpeed.help: Below this speed the handbrake won't start a drift, and a drift ends.

liftAt.label: Lift-off drift from
liftAt.help: Above this share of top speed, letting go of the accelerator while steering hard also starts a drift.

kick.label: Entry flick
kick.help: The nose snaps this far into the corner the moment a drift starts (radians), so the slide begins at once.

grip.label: Grip while drifting
grip.help: Lower = longer, wider slides. Compare with Grip in the car group.

turnBoost.label: Drift turn boost
turnBoost.help: The nose turns this much faster while drifting: a drift takes a tighter line than gripping does.

maxTurn.label: Fastest drift rotation
maxTurn.help: The nose never swings faster than this in a drift (radians per second, before the boost above). Stops a slow drift from turning into a U-turn.

hold.label: Drift self-steer
hold.help: With the handbrake held the car keeps turning in by this share even with the wheel centred. Steering only adjusts the line.

maxSlip.label: Largest slide angle (deg)
maxSlip.help: The slide can never get bigger than this, so the car cannot spin. Bigger looks wilder and is harder to place.

exitSlip.label: Drift ends below (deg)
exitSlip.help: When the slide angle falls under this (you straightened up), the drift ends and the boost fires.

chargeSlip.label: Boost charges above (deg)
chargeSlip.help: The slide must be at least this big to charge the boost.

chargeTime.label: Drift time for a boost (s)
chargeTime.help: Hold a drift this long and you get the small boost when it ends.

chargeFull.label: Drift time for the big boost (s)
chargeFull.help: Hold it this long for the full boost (the sparks turn white).

boostTime.label: Boost length (s)
boostTime.help: How long the full boost lasts. The small boost lasts half as long.

boostTop.label: Boost top speed +
boostTop.help: Extra top speed while boosting (0.16 = 16% faster).

boostKick.label: Boost kick (m/s)
boostKick.help: Speed added the instant the boost fires.

handbrakeDrag.label: Handbrake drag
handbrakeDrag.help: How much holding the handbrake slows the car.

scrub.label: Drift speed loss
scrub.help: Sliding sideways costs this much speed (bigger slide = more). 0 = drifting is free.

wallLoss.label: Rail hit: speed lost per m/s
wallLoss.help: A harder hit costs more speed. Low = rails are friendly.

wallLossMax.label: Rail hit: most speed lost
wallLossMax.help: Even a head-on hit never takes more than this share of your speed. This is why a rail can't stop the car dead.

scrapeDrag.label: Scraping drag
scrapeDrag.help: Speed lost per second while rubbing along a rail.

wallAlign.label: Rail straightens the car
wallAlign.help: How fast a rail turns the nose back along the road. 0 = you have to steer out yourself.

offroadMargin.label: Free metres off the road
offroadMargin.help: You can run this far over the edge line (onto the kerb) before the grass slows you.

offroadTop.label: Top speed on grass
offroadTop.help: Share of top speed you can hold off the road.

offroadDrag.label: Grass slows you this fast
offroadDrag.help: How quickly the grass brings you down to its top speed. Low = gentle.

stuckTime.label: Auto-reset when stuck (s)
stuckTime.help: Pressing a pedal but not moving for this long puts the car back on the road.

wrongWayTime.label: Auto-reset when wrong way (s)
wrongWayTime.help: Driving the wrong way for this long turns the car round.

resetSpeed.label: Speed after a reset (m/s)
resetSpeed.help: A reset puts you back already rolling, so it costs little time.

bumpLoss.label: Car bump softness
bumpLoss.help: How much of the closing speed a bump with another car takes away. 1 = a dead thud, 0 = you pass through.

distance.label: Distance
distance.help: Metres behind the car when standing still.

height.label: Height
height.help: Metres above the car when standing still.

speedDistance.label: Drops back at speed
speedDistance.help: Extra metres behind the car at top speed (the follow lag adds more by itself).

speedDrop.label: Lowers at speed
speedDrop.help: Metres the camera sinks at top speed. Lower to the road = the road rushes more.

fov.label: Field of view
fov.help: How wide the view is when standing still.

speedFov.label: Wider at speed
speedFov.help: Degrees added at top speed. The strongest single speed effect: the edges of the screen stretch away.

boostDistance.label: Drops back when boosting
boostDistance.help: Extra metres behind the car during a boost: the car leaps away from you.

follow.label: Follow tightness
follow.help: Lower = more lag: the car pulls ahead when it accelerates.

turnFollow.label: Swing-round speed
turnFollow.help: How fast the camera gets back behind the car in a turn. Lower shows more of the car's side.

driftSwing.label: Swing out in drifts
driftSwing.help: 0 = always behind the nose. 1 = behind the direction of travel, so a drift shows the car fully side-on.

lookAhead.label: Look ahead (m)
lookAhead.help: The camera looks at a point this far in front of the car.

lookTurn.label: Look into the turn (m)
lookTurn.help: The look point slides this far toward the inside of the corner when you steer.

minHeight.label: Keep above ground (m)
minHeight.help: The camera never gets closer than this to the land under it.

seeThrough.label: See through rivals in the way (m)
seeThrough.help: A rival in the line between the camera and your car turns see-through, fading back in over this many metres to the side, so it never hides you. 0 = always solid.

linesFrom.label: Speed lines from
linesFrom.help: Streaks start to appear above this share of top speed.

linesStrength.label: Speed lines strength
linesStrength.help: How visible the streaks are at top speed. 0 = off (a calmer look).

linesLength.label: Speed lines length
linesLength.help: Metres of streak per m/s of speed.

skidFrom.label: Skid marks from
skidFrom.help: How hard the tyres must slide (0 to 1) before they leave marks and smoke.

smoke.label: Tyre smoke
smoke.help: How much smoke a slide makes.

engineVolume.label: Engine volume
engineVolume.help: The engine hum. Its pitch climbs with speed and drops at each gear change.

windVolume.label: Wind volume
windVolume.help: Wind noise; it grows with the square of speed.

roll.label: Body roll
roll.help: How far the body leans out of a corner. 0 = stiff as a board.

pitch.label: Dive and squat
pitch.help: How far the nose dips under braking and lifts under power.

spring.label: Spring stiffness
spring.help: Higher = the body snaps to its lean faster.

damping.label: Spring damping
damping.help: Lower = the body wobbles after a turn. Higher = it settles at once.

wheelTurn.label: Front wheels turn (rad)
wheelTurn.help: How far the front wheels visibly turn at full lock.

track.label: Track (reload to apply)
track.help: Which track from tracks.js: 0 = Lakeside Circuit, 1 = Pine Loop. Save, then reload the page. Or add ?track=1 to the address.

rivals.label: Rivals
rivals.help: How many computer cars race. 0 turns the game into a time trial (applies on the next restart).

ghost.label: Show best-lap ghost
ghost.help: A see-through car replays your best lap of this session. Made for time trials.

winPosition.label: Win if you finish in the top
winPosition.help: 1 = you must win the race. 3 = a podium is enough.

rocketWindow.label: Rocket start window (s)
rocketWindow.help: Press the accelerator within this long before GO for a boost off the line. Earlier just revs the engine (no penalty).

finishGrace.label: Time to finish after the winner (s)
finishGrace.help: Once a rival wins, you have this long to reach the line before the race is called.

pace.label: Pace
pace.help: The main difficulty dial. Share of their ideal speed the rivals drive at (1 = a good lap; 0.9 = an easy race).

topSpeed.label: Top speed (m/s)
topSpeed.help: Their speed on the straights. Keep it a little under the player's.

cornerGrip.label: Corner speed
cornerGrip.help: How fast they take corners (sideways pull in m/s2). The player's car can pull about 35 without drifting.

brake.label: Braking
brake.help: Lower = they brake earlier and softer for corners.

bandDistance.label: Rubber band reach (m)
bandDistance.help: The catch-up help is at full strength when a rival is this far from the player.

catchUp.label: Rubber band: behind you
catchUp.help: A rival far behind drives this much faster (0.1 = 10%). Keeps someone in your mirrors.

easeOff.label: Rubber band: ahead of you
easeOff.help: A rival far ahead drives this much slower. Keeps first place reachable. 0 on both = an honest race.

mistakeEvery.label: A mistake about every (s)
mistakeEvery.help: Each rival lifts and runs wide about this often.

mistakeSlow.label: Mistake pace
mistakeSlow.help: Share of their pace during a mistake.

laneSpeed.label: Lane change speed (m/s)
laneSpeed.help: How quickly they move across the road to pass or follow their line.

slideShow.label: Tail-out in corners
slideShow.help: How much their tail steps out in tight corners. Only for show.

pace.label: Bot pace
pace.help: How hard the ?bot=1 test driver pushes (it drives your car with your handling).

cornerGrip.label: Bot corner speed
cornerGrip.help: The corner speed the bot plans for. Too high and it meets the rails.

lookAhead.label: Bot look-ahead (s)
lookAhead.help: It steers at a point this many seconds down the road.

steerGain.label: Bot steering strength
steerGain.help: How hard it turns toward its aim point.

wander.label: Bot sloppiness
wander.help: How much it wanders off the ideal line. 0 = a tidy lap.

driftTurn.label: Bot drifts in corners tighter than
driftTurn.help: 1 / corner radius in metres. 0.021 = it drifts corners tighter than about 48 m.

driftHold.label: Bot drift length (s)
driftHold.help: The longest it holds the handbrake.
